psychoacousticSpatialRules.philosophy: This data-set provides the exact mathematical parameters for Fruity Delay 3 to simulate a virtual 3D environment based on the biology of human hearing.

spatialZones.objective: Make the listener feel like the singer is in their own head.
spatialZones.logic: Minimal temporal offset mimics the width of a human skull. High LP preserves the 'Air' of the performance.

spatialZones.objective: Mimic a professional, dampened acoustic environment.
spatialZones.logic: 40ms is just outside the Haas window, creating a distinct reflection that mimics a wall 20 feet away.

spatialZones.objective: Create a vast, atmospheric background shadow.
spatialZones.logic: Aggressive LP filtering and high diffusion remove the 'Identity' of the sound, leaving only the 'Emotion'.
Extreme vibrato and feedback saturation trigger the 'Uncanny Valley' response in the auditory cortex.

collisionRules.action: Set internal HP filter to 450Hz; use 'Invert' feedback mode to cancel low-frequency buildup.
Increase Ducker Threshold to -15dB; set Release to 1/4 note interval in ms.
